parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number. Pages start from page 1.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC.

parameters.name: IsDefend
parameters.description:
Indicates whether the attack is defended. Valid values:

- `0`: detected

- `1`: blocked

parameters.name: Level
parameters.description:
The threat level. The value is a JSON array. Valid values:

- `serious`: high

- `suspicious`: medium

- `remind`: low

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 100.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region in which the data management center of Threat Analysis resides. You can determine the region based on the region in which your assets reside. Valid values:

- `cn-hangzhou`: Your assets reside in the Chinese mainland or Hong Kong (China).

- `ap-southeast-1`: Your assets reside in regions outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: RoleFor
parameters.description: The ID of the member in the resource directory.

parameters.name: RoleType
parameters.description:
The entity of the alert. Valid values:

- `0`: the current Alibaba Cloud account.

- `1`: all members in the resource directory.

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description: The data source of the alert.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC.

parameters.name: SubUserId
parameters.description: The ID of the account that is associated with the alert.
